rationale: This empirical survey study (n = 19,345) investigates how human, financial, infrastructure and cultural resources affect organizational problems (member/volunteer/coach recruitment and retention and club finances) in nonprofit sport clubs in Germany. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access and is excluded under E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings because the study is entirely off-topic (E01), examining organizational capacity and management problems in German nonprofit sport clubs rather than household or community water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Evidence from Nonprofit Sport Clubs in Germany
Nonprofit sport clubs experience organizational problems regarding the recruitment and retention of members, volunteers, and coaches, and the financial situation of the club.
The empirical evaluation is undertaken using data from a nationwide online survey of nonprofit sport clubs in Germany (n = 19,345).
